quotes.text: This is an incredible experience and I highly recommend taking this adventure! Capt. Rob and Capt. Kole are exceptional at making every effort to make sure that you have the best time. We had such a wonderful time enjoying the views of East Bay, but also the boat ride as well. You will want to get the photo package because you will want to have record of this! Make sure that Third Coast Parasail is on your “to do” list – you will not regret it.
